quotes.text: e.22 ¿Cuál es su relación de parentesco con la persona referente del hogar (integrante del hogar N° 1)?
e.23 ¿La madre vive en este hogar?
e.24 ¿El padre vive en este hogar?
e.25 ¿Tiene cónyuge o pareja en este hogar?

e.27 ¿Actualmente está… … separado/a de unión libre anterior? … divorciado/a? … casado/a (incluye separado/a y aún no se divorció)? … viudo/a de casamiento? … viudo/a de unión libre? … soltero/a (nunca se casó ni vivió en unión libre)?

assessments.reasoning: The survey collects individual marital status (e.27) combined with the presence or absence of a spouse/partner in the household (e.25), allowing de jure vs de facto situations to be distinguished. Mother-child links are directly recorded via mother identification (e.23), father identification (e.24), and partner presence (e.25), which allows unpartnered mother-child units to be identified even inside larger extended households. Section G measures personal income at the individual level for each household member, enabling identification of households or sub-units maintained by women based on the main financial provider regardless of who is declared as the reference person in e.22. However, household consumption and expenditure are collected at the aggregate household level (Section I and Section J), and there are no variables linking specific sub-household mother-child units to their own distinct consumption, production, or care activity.
